时笙和两个妹纸聊得很开心，甚至到后面互换了手机号码。

等陆清韵接到陆老爷子，被几个保镖护送着离开，不少人才发现时笙，一时间机场热闹了起来。

好在陆老爷子的保镖够彪悍，一行人有惊无险的离开机场。

不少粉丝纷纷表示受到一万点伤害。

#小丸子竟然和我同处一个机场，然而我没有看到#

#小丸子和金主大人大庭广众之下秀恩爱，狗粮我要鸡肉味的#

#大大亲笔签名，帅得不要不要的，我感觉要弯了#

最后一条被顶得最多，不但有近距离照片，还有合照和签名。许多粉丝纷纷表示羡慕嫉妒恨，她们怎么就没发现自家大大呢？

在网上的人被虐到的时候，时笙和陆清韵正陪着陆老爷子吃饭。

“小晚啊，你看你和这兔崽子也交往这么久了，什么时候把婚礼办了？”陆老爷子和蔼可亲的看着时笙。

时笙拿着勺子的手一抖，干笑道：“陆爷爷……我们还小。”

久？久个屁啊！

而且本宝宝只想花陆清韵的钱，没想着嫁给他啊！

陆老爷子，您表要乱拉红线！

“不小了不小了，我像这兔崽子那么大的时候，他爸都能打酱油了。爷爷老了，想要在活着的时候看一眼重孙子……”

时笙在桌子底下踢了陆清韵一脚，陆清韵却只是淡淡的扫了她一眼，转头就对着陆老爷子道：“爷爷，您选个日子吧，我和小晚都听您的。”

“什么！”

陆清韵和陆老爷子同时看向时笙，时笙连忙捂嘴，“那个……我只是觉得太快了，我觉得我和……清韵还要在培养培养一下感情，对，在培养一下！”

说到后面，时笙重重的点点头。

“哈哈哈哈，结婚后培养也是一样的一样的，而且爷爷看你们感情那是好得很啊！”陆爷爷脸上都快笑开花儿了，“这事就这么定了，一会儿就回去看看日子。”

他可是看到网上新闻才专门回来的。

“不是……”

“小晚，你家里还有什么人，和爷爷说说，爷爷也好安排安排。”

“我……”不嫁啊！

“小兔崽子，婚礼你得仔细准备，可不能委屈了小晚，否则我饶不了你。”

“爷爷放心。”

时笙：“……”特么的让我说句话啊！！

本宝宝还没答应呢？

你们就这么自说自话真的好吗？

Shi Sheng had a great time chatting with the two girls, and even exchanged mobile phone numbers later.

When Lu Qingyun received Mr. Lu and was escorted away by several bodyguards, many people discovered Shi Sheng, and the airport became lively for a while.

Fortunately, Mr. Lu's bodyguards were tough enough, and the group left the airport without any danger.

Many fans expressed that they suffered 10,000 points of damage.

#小 Maruko was actually at the same airport as me, but I didn’t see it#

#小肉子 and the sponsor show off their affection in public, I want chicken-flavored dog food#

#大大Autographed, so handsome, I feel like I’m going to bend#

The last post received the most likes, as it not only contained close-up photos, but also group photos and autographs.Many fans expressed their envy and hatred. Why didn't they realize that they were older?

When people online were being abused, Shi Sheng and Lu Qingyun were having dinner with Mr. Lu.

"Xiao Wan, you and this bastard have been dating for so long. When did you hold the wedding?" Mr. Lu looked at Shi Sheng amiably.

Shi Sheng's hand holding the spoon shook and he laughed dryly: "Grandpa Lu... we are still young."

How long?What a long time!

And this baby only wants to spend Lu Qingyun’s money, not marry him!

Mr. Lu, you are trying to pull the red line!

"Not too young, not too young. When I was as old as this bastard, his father was already able to do so. Grandpa is old and wants to see his great-grandson while he is still alive..."

Shi Sheng kicked Lu Qingyun under the table, but Lu Qingyun just glanced at her lightly, turned to Mr. Lu and said, "Grandpa, please choose a day. Xiaowan and I will listen to you."

"What!"

Lu Qingyun and Mr. Lu looked at Shi Sheng at the same time, and Shi Sheng quickly covered her mouth, "Well... I just think it's too fast. I think... Qingyun and I still need to cultivate our relationship, yes, we need to cultivate it!"

After speaking, Shi Sheng nodded heavily.

"Hahahaha, training after marriage is the same, and grandpa thinks your relationship is very good!" Grandpa Lu's face almost burst into laughter, "This matter is settled, I will go back and see what the future holds."

He came back specifically after seeing the news online.

"No..."

"Xiaowan, if there is anyone else in your family, please tell grandpa so that he can make arrangements."

"I..." I won't marry!

"Little bastard, you have to prepare for the wedding carefully, but you can't wrong Xiao Wan, otherwise I won't be able to spare you."

"Grandpa, don't worry."

Shi Sheng: "..." Damn, let me say something!!

This baby hasn’t agreed yet?

Is it really okay for you to just talk to yourselves like this?
